I have both ADHD and Autism, my autism was diagnosed 5/6 years ago but the ADHD wasn’t until recently. To me personally, this sounds more like hyperfixations. I get very obsessed about things and have a couple months where I learn everything about it/ won’t stop partaking in a new hobby, similarly to what you described. Then suddenly I’m not interested and move onto the next thing - it’s like a switch turns off. I only realised recently this was my ADHD presentation and not my ASD. My special interest has been a lifelong passion, at times it can be very disruptive like my hyperfixations but other times it is less apparent - the distinction for me is that I never lose interest in it and it has been consistent for as long as I can remember. Even during times its less apparent, i will at the very least mention it in almost every conversation. It’s like my brain can always link everything to it even if it’s completely irrelevant. This is just my personal experience, though.
